title: Our Forest
text:
There is a big forest near my village. Many trees live there. Birds sing in the morning. Deer drink water from the river. I love to walk in the forest with my dog.

The forest is very important. It gives us clean air. Animals need it to live. Please do not throw trash in the forest. We must protect nature.

questions.text: What sings in the morning in the forest?
What does the forest give us?
Why should people not throw trash in the forest?
options: Because animals need a clean forest to live
Because the forest is far away

questions.text: How does the writer feel about the forest?
options: The writer is afraid of it
The writer does not know it
The writer wants to leave it

vocabulary.definition: a large area covered with trees
to keep something safe from harm

paragraph_translations: Köyümün yakınında büyük bir orman var. Orada birçok ağaç yaşıyor. Sabahları kuşlar şarkı söyler. Geyikler nehirden su içer. Köpeğimle ormanda yürümeyi çok severim.
Orman çok önemlidir. Bize temiz hava verir. Hayvanların yaşamak için ormana ihtiyacı var. Lütfen ormana çöp atmayın. Doğayı korumalıyız.
